prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI icon atlas for the VOICES exploration game. Create exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 16 equal square cells, TRUE transparent RGBA background. Input image 1 is the game's polished prop art style; image 2 is its character art style. Create original inventory/menu icons, miniature believable game objects with crisp dark aubergine outlines, controlled finely textured pixel shading, warm wood, old brass, teal, plum, ochre and leaf green colors, charming handmade game aesthetic. These must look like collectible sprites from the game, not generic flat SVG line icons, not emoji, not white symbols. Strong simple silhouettes readable at 32 pixels. Exactly one complete centered icon per cell with 12% empty alpha gutter. No tile backplates, no badges behind the objects, no enclosing square, no cast shadows, no text, no letters, no grid, no background color. EXACT left-to-right row order: Row1: 1 purple-and-teal adventure backpack with brass buckle (inventory); 2 closed plum investigator journal with small brass clasp and a bookmark (journal); 3 teal clipboard with cream paper and three distinct golden check marks (objectives); 4 open wood-and-teal-bound reading notebook with pencil (notebook). Row2: 5 open heritage book with a tiny framed portrait and carved wooden artifact on its two pages (heritage); 6 unfolded parchment town map with green paths and one red pin (map); 7 welcoming terracotta-roof cottage with tiny leafy garden (homes); 8 gold trophy with teal ribbon (challenges). Row3: 9 the friendly tiny teal PIX robot face with glowing blue screen and two square eyes (pix); 10 dark wooden archive box with brass label plate and stacked folders (archive); 11 three distinctive friendly chibi community heads, different hair silhouettes and brown skin tones (community); 12 seedling with three leaves emerging from a clump of earth (leaf). Row4: 13 circular brass compass with red needle and teal face (compass); 14 wooden painter's palette with colorful paint and brush (scene editor); 15 small wooden-framed chalkboard with a brass pointer and book, blank board (teacher); 16 friendly speech bubble made from an organic cream paper scroll with three teal dots, with a small teal microphone in front (voice). Cohesive carefully drawn polished game sprites. Fully opaque colors inside the objects and true alpha zero in empty areas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI utility icon atlas for VOICES. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, sixteen equal square cells, true transparent RGBA. References give the game's warm finely shaded prop sprites and outlined character aesthetic. Match that polished cozy fine-pixel game art: bold crisp dark outlines, small controlled highlights, wood and old brass, plum, teal, ochre and sage accents. Miniature illustrated objects, NOT generic flat vector icons, NOT white line pictograms, NOT emoji. Every icon strongly readable at 32 pixels. Each full object fits its own square cell with 12% empty alpha gutters. No square backplates, no tiles behind icons, no baked floor shadows, no text labels, no grid lines, no paper or colored backdrop, preserve true alpha 0 outside objects. Exact row order left to right: Row1: 1 two interlocking brass gears with teal centers and a small wooden tuning lever (settings); 2 little wooden speaker cabinet with teal cone and three short golden sound waves (sound); 3 two polished brass pause bars mounted in a very small dark wooden base (pause); 4 a teal triangular right-pointing play crystal set in a tiny brass rim (resume). Row2: 5 closed plum adventure journal with brass clasp and a bright tiny teal save crystal (save); 6 parchment scroll lying in a wooden document tray with a clear small golden DOWN arrow (export); 7 parchment scroll hovering above a wooden document tray with a clear small golden UP arrow (import); 8 open warm wooden doorway with a gold door handle and tiny leafy threshold (exit). Row3: 9 little teal leather help book with a golden QUESTION MARK on its cover (help); 10 four carved wood corner brackets and four small outward golden arrows, central empty alpha space (expand); 11 brass magnifying glass with teal lens and wood handle (search); 12 brass-and-wood hourglass with pale amber sand (history). Row4: 13 small brass telescope on a wooden tripod with a tiny glass flask beside it (science); 14 brass and teal microscope with small green leaf specimen (biology); 15 wooden djembe with teal strap and two tiny golden music notes (music); 16 small wood-and-brass portrait frame with a friendly original brown-skinned curly-haired young adult chibi face in purple clothing (profile). Consistent scale and visually balanced optical weight. High quality illustrated game assets, opaque interior colors and actual clean transparency surrounding every object.

Reference is the chosen menu icon atlas; match its precise warm outlined game sprite aesthetic, plum and teal, hand-painted finely textured shading, old brass, wood, ochre and sage; collectible game items, not flat vector pictograms, not emojis. Each object is complete and centered, with 12% clear alpha gutter in its cell. Large simple silhouettes readable at 32 pixels. No enclosing backplates, no floor, no baked shadows, no background color, no grid or text labels. Row1 left to right: 1 three overlapping gold coins with a simple embossed leaf on the front coin, small green gleam (coins); 2 a handheld fictional HISTORIOGRAPH memory scanner, compact dark wooden body with brass corners, large round teal glass lens, two plum buttons, small brass antenna, recognizable as a handheld exploration device rather than a compass (historio); 3 an appetizing golden roasted chicken drumstick with a white bone tip and subtle herb leaf, no plate (care-meat); 4 a rounded teal explorer water canteen with brass cap and small clear blue droplet beside it (care-water). Row2 left to right: 5 a plum rolled sleeping mat with golden crescent moon tucked against it (care-sleep); 6 wood market produce crate with bright orange, green and purple fruits, one green leaf (market); 7 a short rustic wooden trail signpost with a red map pin mounted above it and small grass at foot (pin); 8 a cream parchment sheet with a plum feather quill in a tiny brass inkwell, no lettering (paper). True empty alpha between all objects; opaque rich colors inside sprites. Cohesive with the supplied icon sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a dedicated pause-menu vignette illustration for the VOICES cozy exploration game, landscape 3:2 or 16:10. This is actual game menu art, not a UI mockup. Style references: supplied polished game prop sprites and character sprite, clean dark outlines, warm fine-pixel inspired painterly shading, charming stylized game proportions; no photorealism. A quiet wooden reading desk beside an open library window at warm dusk: the small friendly teal PIX robot with two cyan square eyes resting beside a plum travel journal, brass compass, a rolled parchment map with teal river, pencil and a leafy cutting in a terracotta pot. Outside the window are a softly rendered yellow ipê and silhouettes of the game's town, cozy amber window light, sage foliage. Balanced small still life, readable from 260 pixels wide, carefully drawn materials, believable cast shadows, restrained amber highlights against deep forest-green and muted plum background. Center the PIX robot and journal around the middle, keep clear dark space on upper edge to allow a live profile portrait to overlap later. No human faces, no text, no logos, no buttons, no border, no UI elements, no white/cream backdrop. Finished richly illustrated menu asset in the same art language as the supplied game props.
